correct: You don't need to pose
rule: need to 後面接原形動詞 (base verb)，不是動名詞

correct: To be perfectly candid, I think...
rule: 開頭引導語要用不定詞片語 (infinitive phrase)，不是原形動詞

correct: Oh, it's so close! / That was almost it!
rule: 表達「差一點點」時，母語者會用更生動的反應句

wrong: I have an example to using
correct: I have an example of how to use
rule: example 後面接 of + how to + 動詞，不能直接用 to + V-ing

correct: It combines
rule: 第三人稱單數 (it) 後面動詞要加 s / es

wrong: I'd go to sleep (表示將要)
correct: I'm going to go to sleep / I'm heading to bed
rule: I'd 是 I would（假設語氣），不是「我將要」; 表達打算用 I'm going to

correct: Pioneers in AI / a pioneer in the field of AI
rule: 表示「某領域的先驅者」，慣用 pioneer in + 領域

correct: Study AI topics during work hours / while working
rule: during 後面接名詞 (work hours)，while 後面才接 V-ing

correct: It's okay with me / I'm fine with it
rule: 表達「沒問題」時，慣用 okay with me

correct: Provide it to my other colleagues / share it with my colleagues
rule: 修正拼寫 (colleagues) 並補上正確受詞

correct: Makes work more convenient / makes work easier
rule: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 形容詞 (convenient)，而非副詞 (conveniently)

correct: Write a letter in English
rule: 語言介質一律使用介系詞 in

correct: Follow a formal email format / match the required format
rule: 格式建議用 follow 或 match，而不是 meet

wrong: The key to make presentation better is streamline
correct: The key to making a presentation better is to streamline / streamlining
rule: The key to 後方必須接 V-ing 或名詞

wrong: It's so many things happen today
correct: So many things happened today
rule: 描述今天發生的事，使用過去式 happened，不需要 It's 開頭

wrong: I let my colleague do me a favor
correct: I asked my colleague for a favor
rule: 請求幫忙慣用 ask someone for a favor

correct: I could tell he was frustrated
rule: 描述感覺應使用形容詞 frustrated，而非名詞 frustration

wrong: Asked him if he is sad
correct: Asked him if he was upset
rule: 職場情境用 upset（不悅）比 sad（悲傷）更自然

correct: The words sounded impatient
rule: 描述說話方式用形容詞 impatient（不耐煩的）

correct: I learned a lesson
rule: 學到「教訓」用 learn a lesson；class 僅指課程

wrong: Then I use '~' in the end of the sentence
correct: Now I use '~' at the end of my sentences
rule: 描述目前習慣用現在式，at the end of 是固定搭配

correct: The most challenging thing
rule: 形容「具挑戰性的事物」用形容詞 challenging

wrong: The opposite team also have some statements
correct: The opposing team also had some arguments
rule: 辯論對手用 opposing team；論點用 arguments 或 points

wrong: Your family are not always by your side
correct: Your family isn't always by your side
rule: family 在此作為單數整體，搭配 isn't

correct: Convenient apps
rule: 使用形容詞 convenient 修飾名詞

correct: The most impressive point / most impactful argument
rule: 用形容詞 impressive 描述令人印象深刻的內容

correct: If the factory has an issue
rule: 加上定冠詞 the，issue 是可數名詞，用 an issue

wrong: I refute the statement that we are not slave
correct: I refuted: 'We are not slaves!'
rule: 使用過去式 refuted；slave 應使用複數 slaves

correct: Pretended someone was calling me
rule: 描述過去動作使用過去式 pretended

correct: Break the tension / lighten the mood
rule: 慣用語為 break the tension 或 lighten the mood

wrong: I just want to share the day to you
correct: I just wanted to share my day with you
rule: 固定搭配 share ... with someone

correct: I hope work goes smoothly / everything goes smoothly
rule: smoothly 是副詞，必須接在動詞 (goes) 之後

wrong: I got the acclaim by the colleague
correct: My colleagues praised me today / I got some praise
rule: acclaim 用於極大成就；日常讚美用 praise 更自然

correct: There was an issue
rule: issue 以元音開頭，使用冠詞 an

wrong: The text may shows error cause it's simpled Chinese
correct: The text showed errors because it was in Simplified Chinese
rule: 修正時態 showed，正確術語 Simplified Chinese

correct: I shared it with my colleagues
rule: 修正時態 shared，搭配介詞 with

correct: Oh, it's so close! / That was almost it!
rule: 表達「差一點點」時，母語者會用更生動的反應句，而不是直譯

correct: I,m going to go to sleep / I'm heading to bed
rule: I'd 是 I would 的縮寫（表示假設或過去習慣），不是「我將要」的意思

correct: pioneers in AI / a pioneer in the field of AI
rule: 修正搭配詞，使用 "pioneer in [field]" 更為自然。

correct: study AI topics during work hours / while working
rule: 修正時間表達，"during working" 並非標準用法。

correct: it's okay with me / I'm fine with it
rule: 表達同意或沒問題時，慣用 "okay with me"。

correct: provide it to my other colleagues / share it with my colleagues
rule: 修正拼寫 (colleagues) 並補上受詞。

correct: makes work more convenient / makes work easier
rule: 使役動詞 make + 受詞 + 形容詞 (convenient)，而非副詞 (conveniently)。

correct: write a letter in English
rule: 語言介質一律使用介系詞 "in"。

correct: follow a formal email format / match the required formal format
rule: 格式建議使用 "follow" 或 "match"，而非 "meet"。

wrong: asked him if he is sad
correct: asked him if he was upset
rule: 在職場情境中，用 "upset" (不悅/生氣) 比 "sad" (悲傷) 更自然。

correct: the words sounded impatient
rule: 描述說話方式應使用形容詞 "impatient" (不耐煩的)。

wrong: Then I use "~" in the end of the sentence
correct: Now I use "~" at the end of my sentences
rule: 描述目前習慣使用現在式。

correct: the most challenging thing
rule: 形容「具挑戰性的事物」應使用形容詞 "challenging"。

wrong: your family are not always by your side
correct: your family isn't always by your side
rule: family 在此作為單數整體，使用 isn't。

correct: convenient apps
rule: 使用形容詞 "convenient" 修飾名詞。

correct: if the factory has an issue
rule: 加上定冠詞 "the" 且 issue 是可數名詞，用 "an issue"。

correct: pretended someone was calling me
rule: 描述過去發生的動作，使用過去式 "pretended"。

correct: break the tension / lighten the mood
rule: 慣用語為 "break the tension"。

wrong: the text may shows error cause it's simpled Chinese
correct: the text showed errors because it was in Simplified Chinese
rule: 修正時態 (showed) 以及正確的術語 (Simplified Chinese)。

wrong: sweet shrimp that can be sashimi
correct: sweet shrimp that can be eaten as sashimi
rule: 澄清蝦子是被食用作為刺身，而非蝦子本身就是刺身。

correct: let us taste them
rule: let 後接原形動詞 (base verb)。

correct: I wanted to buy
rule: 描述過去發生的事情使用過去式。

correct: only sold big boxes
rule: 使用動詞 "sell" (過去式 "sold")，而非名詞 "sale"。

wrong: bring to the restaurant to require for cook
correct: brought them to a restaurant and asked them to cook it for us
rule: 使用過去式 "brought"，且請求服務時用 "ask" 比 "require" 更自然。

wrong: Doesn't it have interesting idiom you want to share to me?
correct: Do you have any interesting idioms you want to share with me?
rule: 修正疑問句結構以及搭配詞 "share with"。

correct: shrimp
rule: shrimp 的單複數同形，通常不加 s。

correct: weren't very fresh / weren't that fresh
rule: 在否定句中，修飾形容詞建議用 "very" 或 "that"。

wrong: I will go there next time for the fresher shrimp
correct: I'll go back next time for fresher shrimp
rule: 回到某地慣用 "go back"。

wrong: it became wet and get sticky
correct: it got mushy and sticky
rule: 描述過熟水果建議使用 mushy，且時態需統一為過去式。

wrong: I left the company on time
correct: I left work on time / I got off work on time
rule: 表達下班離開公司，慣用 "leave work" 或 "get off work"。

correct: took out the trash
rule: 描述今天已完成的動作，使用過去式。

wrong: Why it's hit the nail on the head?
correct: Why is it 'hit the nail on the head'?
rule: 疑問句結構應為 "Why is it [phrase]?"。

correct: do some cardio
rule: 在健身房情境中，習慣用 "cardio" 代替 "aerobic exercise"。

wrong: train of the chest or back
correct: train chest or back / do a chest or back workout
rule: train 後直接接身體部位，不需加 "of the"。
